_comment: Tray filtering and icon overrides. Hand-edited; the shell watches this
file and re-reads it on save, so no restart is needed.
Ids are matched case-insensitively as SUBSTRINGS, because an app's
StatusNotifierItem id is not always stable -- Steam's carries a pid, and
some apps append a number when a second instance starts. So 'steam'
Every item's real id is shown in the tray drawer's tooltip and listed by
`qs log` on first sight, so there is no guessing about what to type here.
pinned  shown directly in the bar rather than inside the drawer
only    if non-empty, a WHITELIST: nothing outside it is shown
icons   id -> freedesktop icon name, or a path, replacing the app's own
